name: Every injury entry uses a standard severity from a fixed vocabulary
description: When the per-match lineups artifact is fetched, every entry in the home and away injuries arrays carries a non-empty player name, a reason, and a severity drawn from the fixed vocabulary out, doubtful, suspended, or returning.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-lineups/<first-id>.json using the captured id
Collect every entry from the home.injuries and away.injuries arrays
Verify every injury entry that is present has a non-empty name and a non-empty reason
Verify every injury entry that is present has a severity equal to one of out, doubtful, suspended, or returning
